entities.summary: Benjamin N. Garland is an American former professional football player who was a center in the National Football League (NFL) for the Denver Broncos, Atlanta Falcons, and San Francisco 49ers. He played college football for the Air Force Falcons. Garland was originally a defensive lineman before converting to an offensive lineman in 2012.
